string.name: onboarding_welcome_description
string.value: Let text, images, and files flow naturally between your trusted devices.

string.name: onboarding_sync_title
string.value: Create or join a sync space

string.name: onboarding_sync_description
string.value: Open Settings to create a space or scan an invitation. Devices in the same space can discover each other and start syncing.

string.name: onboarding_trusted_devices
string.value: Content only moves between devices you authorize

string.name: onboarding_history_description
string.value: Send content from Clipboard, then search, star, or pin desktop history so useful items stay close.

string.name: onboarding_history_text_note
string.value: Write it to this device's clipboard

string.name: onboarding_history_image_note
string.value: Pick them up on another device

string.name: onboarding_privacy_title
string.value: More than a clipboard, with privacy built in

string.name: onboarding_privacy_description
string.value: UniClipboard supports text, images, and files. Transfers use an encrypted space, while sensitive credentials stay in system secure storage.

string.name: share_target_description
string.value: Send shared content to a trusted device

string.name: share_target_no_devices
string.value: There are no other devices in this space yet

string.name: share_target_not_joined
string.value: Open UniClipboard first and create or join a sync space.

string.name: share_target_unsupported
string.value: This selection is not supported. Share one text item, image, or file at a time.

string.name: share_target_send_failed
string.value: Could not send. Make sure the target device is online and try again.

string.name: share_target_load_failed
string.value: The device service took too long to start. Try again.

string.name: entry_pasteboard_permission_reason
string.value: Used to read the clipboard and sync it to trusted devices after you enable background auto-sync

string.name: camera_permission_reason
string.value: Used to scan optical transfer codes shown on another device

string.name: optical_transfer_subtitle
string.value: Transfer through a screen and camera, with no network

string.name: optical_send_note
string.value: Sends the selected file, image, or composer text first, then falls back to the latest item. Keep the screen on and aim the receiving device at the code.

string.name: optical_receive_note
string.value: Aim the viewfinder at the animated code on the other device. Missed frames need no retransmission; content is restored and verified automatically.

string.name: optical_send_ready
string.value: An animated QR stream will appear when ready

string.name: optical_no_content
string.value: There is no content to send, or QR generation failed

string.name: optical_too_large
string.value: This version supports up to 4 MB. Choose a smaller item.

string.name: optical_receive_ready
string.value: Open the camera to search for an optical stream

string.name: optical_camera_denied
string.value: Camera access is required. Grant permission and try again.

string.name: optical_receive_failed
string.value: Receiving or integrity verification failed. Scan again.
